<!--
Release notes are generated from PR titles/descriptions — fill this out for a human reader
who will never see the diff. Keep it terse and factual.
-->

## Type
<!-- Pick one. This should match the Conventional Commits type used in the PR title/commits. -->
- [ ] feat — new feature or user-visible capability
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] perf — performance improvement
- [ ] chore — dependency bump, tooling, no user-facing change
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] refactor — internal change, no behavior change

## Summary
<!--
1-3 bullet points, written as release-note entries for end users.
Describe user-visible outcome, not implementation. Past tense.
Example: "Fixed the commit graph drifting right when scrolling older history."
-->
-
